test.create_query: CREATE TABLE prewhere_like_probe (c1 DateTime, c2 String, c3 String, c4 Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (c2, c1)
CREATE TABLE prewhere_like_build (k String) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY k
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO prewhere_like_probe SELECT toDateTime('2020-01-01 00:00:00') + number, if(number % 200 = 0, concat('K', toString(number % 7), 'Q[AB]@Z'), concat('K', toString(number % 997), '@Z')), concat(hex(sipHash128(number)), hex(sipHash128(toString(number)))), number / 7 FROM numbers(20000000)
INSERT INTO prewhere_like_build SELECT c3 FROM prewhere_like_probe WHERE c2 LIKE '%Q[AB]@%'
test.query: SELECT count(), sum(p.c4) FROM prewhere_like_probe AS p INNER JOIN prewhere_like_build AS b ON p.c3 = b.k WHERE p.c2 LIKE '%Q[AB]@%' SETTINGS enable_join_runtime_filters = 1
SELECT count(), sum(c4) FROM prewhere_like_probe WHERE c2 LIKE '%Q[AB]@%' AND c3 LIKE '%AB%'
SELECT count(), sum(c4) FROM prewhere_like_probe WHERE match(c2, 'Q.AB.@') AND c3 LIKE '%AB%'
